PHASE_1.name: Discovery & Architecture Alignment
PHASE_1.description: Establish requirements, architecture, and operating models across store and mobile escape room experiences.

todos.title: Benchmark competitor capabilities and identify EscapePlan differentiators
acceptanceCriteria: Document competitor feature matrix covering OffTheCouch, Houdini MC, Escape Room Master, Escape Room Admin, and ClueMaster.
Highlight differentiators for offline-first Pi deployments and mobile event support.
Publish summary in project overview and session notes.
notes: Focus on booking workflows, game runner capabilities, hardware requirements, and pricing models.
Capture gaps those products leave for offline/mobile operations.
Update recorded 2025-09-29: Competitive landscape table added to project-docs/project-overview.md §1.1.1 with differentiators.

todos.title: Define EscapePlan MVP scope, success metrics, and release boundaries
acceptanceCriteria: Enumerate MVP feature list segmented by store-front and mobile operations.
Document quantitative success metrics (uptime, setup time, operator flow speed).
Record out-of-scope features for later roadmap versions.
notes: Include KPIs such as max setup time for mobile events, targeted session stability, and operator efficiency goals.
Update PRD sections 1.4 and 17 accordingly.
Scope segmentation initiated; see project-docs/project-overview.md §1.4 and roadmap §17.
Scope + metrics finalized in project-docs/project-overview.md §§1.4–1.7 and roadmap §17. Future features parked under deferred backlog.

todos.title: Document hardware and network baseline for Pi + AC600M adapter
acceptanceCriteria: Specify Raspberry Pi 5 performance envelope incl. expected concurrent streams.
Detail AC600M AP configuration parameters and channel planning.
List required peripherals for storefront and mobile deployments (power, audio, display).
notes: Capture power requirements and expected battery options for mobile rig.
Align with hostapd/dnsmasq capabilities planned in Phase 2.
Hardware baseline captured in §2.5 with Pi 5, storage, Wi-Fi, power guidance.

todos.title: Establish domain model and service context diagrams
acceptanceCriteria: Produce domain model covering users, games, rooms, bookings, sessions, hints, cameras, discount/deposit flows.
Map bounded contexts for API, streaming, scheduling, and reporting services.
Upload diagrams/notes to project-docs/architecture/ (text outline acceptable for MVP planning).
notes: Include event flow from booking creation to session completion.
Call out integrations between platform base services and Fastify API.
Domain/service breakdown documented in §3.4 covering contexts and interactions.

todos.title: Define UX strategy and DaisyUI theme tokens
acceptanceCriteria: Create DaisyUI custom theme with dark palette (#C43131, #00D5C8 accents).
Outline responsive layout guidelines for mobile-first dashboards.
Document component hierarchy for operator workflows.
notes: Reference DaisyUI v5.1.25 configuration and Tailwind 4 setup requirements.
Address accessibility targets (WCAG AA).
DaisyUI theme tokens + layout guidance added in §8.6; typography clarified.

todos.title: Map dual-repo architecture and delivery workflows
acceptanceCriteria: Document repository layouts for escapeplan-base and escapeplan-web.
Define CI/CD pipeline stages for image builds, API tests, and PWA deploy artifacts.
List branching strategy and release cadence assumptions.
notes: Include pnpm workspace boundaries and shared package approach.
Plan for semantic-release integration.

todos.title: Detail store-front vs mobile operations scenarios
acceptanceCriteria: Capture daily flow for physical location including turnover and reset tasks.
Capture mobile event workflow from booking to teardown.
List data and hardware differentiators between the two modes.
notes: Use prior business experience to outline constraints such as travel time and limited connectivity.
Feed results into bookings and mobile kit user stories.

PHASE_2.name: Platform Base Image & Automation
PHASE_2.description: Build the Raspberry Pi base image, networking stack, and operational automation for EscapePlan deployments.

todos.title: Scaffold escapeplan-base pi-gen pipeline
acceptanceCriteria: pi-gen customization repo initialized with build:image command.
Base image boots with required packages (Node.js 22, ffmpeg, nginx).
Continuous build documented in README.
Base image provisions avahi-daemon, generates self-signed cert bundle, and installs escapeplan CLI tools.
notes: Store GNUPG key handling and package pinning for reproducible builds.
Ensure build works on CI runner targeting arm64.
Ensure pi-gen build includes Avahi, self-signed cert generation, and CLI utilities (cert-export).

todos.title: Automate Wi-Fi AP and local network configuration
acceptanceCriteria: hostapd and dnsmasq templates generated with EscapePlan SSID and DHCP range.
Services auto-start on boot and survive power cycles.
Document channel selection and captive portal bypass instructions.
Default WPA2-PSK generated with ability to rotate via CLI; WPA3 deferred.
notes: Support fallback ethernet config for bench setup.
Include mobile hotspot performance tuning for crowded RF environments.
Include instructions for updating PSK and sharing QR code for staff devices.

todos.title: Provision systemd services and worker supervision
acceptanceCriteria: Define escapeplan-api.service, escapeplan-ffmpeg@.service, and dependencies on nginx.
Add watchdog/Restart parameters and health checks for each service.
Document manual start/stop procedures in runbook.
notes: Ensure ffmpeg units pick up camera environment variables at runtime.
Plan for templated units per camera slug.
Verify mDNS (`escapeplan.local`) and HTTPS cert health surfaced in maintenance dashboard.

todos.title: Implement telemetry, logging, and health endpoints
acceptanceCriteria: Configure journald log rotation and retention for API and ffmpeg logs.
Expose local health endpoint aggregating systemd status and disk space.
Document log collection and troubleshooting steps.
notes: Consider lightweight metrics via node exporter or custom Fastify endpoint.
Support offline log export to USB.

todos.title: Define security hardening and backup routines
acceptanceCriteria: Document user accounts, SSH access policy, and firewall rules for offline network.
Implement automated SQLite backups with retention policy.
Add checksum/restore procedure to runbook.
notes: Ensure backups include asset media and HLS state.
Plan for encrypted offload via USB drive.
Ship self-signed TLS bundle via cert-export CLI and document trust steps; leave SSH disabled by default.

todos.title: Design OTA update and rollback strategy
acceptanceCriteria: Select update transport (e.g., USB package vs. local web interface).
Define versioning/rollback process for base image and application packages.
Update runbook with operator-friendly instructions.
notes: Consider delta updates to minimize downtime.
Include verification steps before applying updates.
Include guidance for regenerating certificates when hostname changes; ensure rollback handles mDNS records.

PHASE_3.name: Backend Core Services
PHASE_3.description: Implement Fastify services, SQLite schema, seeds, and APIs covering games, bookings, sessions, and cameras.

todos.title: Set up Fastify monorepo structure and configuration
acceptanceCriteria: Initialize pnpm workspace for API with linting, testing, and shared types packages.
Add Fastify plugin architecture with configuration modules.
Document local dev script usage in README.
notes: Include environment variable schema validation using Zod.
Plan for integration with Socket.IO namespace.

todos.title: Implement SQLite schema and Drizzle migrations
acceptanceCriteria: Model all core tables with foreign keys and constraints per PRD section 3.
Generate migration scripts and automated migration runner.
Include indexes to support booking lookup and session timeline queries.
notes: Ensure WAL mode configured and vacuum schedule documented.
Validate schema using unit tests against Drizzle.
Initial Drizzle migration folder scaffolding and runtime hook wired; TypeScript lint failing until allowImportingTsExtensions configured.
Rollback dev environment to host-specific node_modules to restore @rollup/rollup-linux-x64-gnu before running migration + seed tests.
2025-09-29: Seed pipeline now hydrates Pirate Mutiny data only, enforces Argon2id hashed credentials, and auto-creates network profile without mock sessions.

todos.title: Create seed data pipeline with realistic baseline data
acceptanceCriteria: Seed roles, default admin, representative games, rooms, puzzles, hints, pricing tiers.
Ensure seeds can be rerun idempotently without duplicate data.
Store seed content under version control without mock placeholders.
notes: Use actual game names from business inventory where permitted.
Include mobile kit templates for Phase 5 use.

todos.title: Deliver authentication and RBAC services
acceptanceCriteria: Implement Argon2id password hashing and session cookie issuance.
Provide user management endpoints with role assignments and password reset flow.
Add middleware enforcing RBAC matrix for Admin, Manager, Game Master, Customer, Mobile Coordinator.
notes: Include rate limiting and account lockouts for repeated failures.
Support offline password reset using admin console.
2025-09-29: Fastify auth now issues short-lived tokens with role-based permissions; admin/user/password endpoints shipped, persistent session store pending.
2025-09-29: Runes-enabled console + logout fix in place; evaluating Better-Auth for persistent sessions and audit trail.
2025-09-29: Operators can now PATCH /users/me to update display name, email, avatar, and bio; admin user endpoints accept the new profile fields.

todos.title: Implement game, room, puzzle, and hint management APIs
acceptanceCriteria: CRUD endpoints with validation for games, rooms, puzzles, hints, and media assets.
Link puzzles to hints with ordering and visibility controls.
Enforce slug uniqueness per game for timer pages.
Expose fields for is_mobile flag, room_theme, and room_screen_asset uploads.
notes: Include file upload handling storing metadata in assets table.
Add audit events for content updates.
2025-09-29: Delivered CRUD APIs and Svelte admin consoles for games/rooms/puzzles; still need audit logging and media workflows.
2025-09-29: Admin dashboards wired to real data with runes; plan dedicated UX polish pass next phase.
Prior nav/profile overhaul already documented in Session 3 notes; retaining earlier entry.

todos.title: Build booking and scheduling API for store and mobile events
acceptanceCriteria: Support recurring availability templates for physical rooms.
Support mobile event bookings with travel buffer and equipment allocation.
Prevent conflicts via transactional checks and provide pricing breakdown.
Support discount codes, deposits (default 30%), and capture location notes for mobile bookings without travel automation.
notes: Include API to track deposit and balance status even without payment processing.
Return ICS exports for booking confirmations.

todos.title: Implement session lifecycle, timers, and hint dispatch
acceptanceCriteria: Provide endpoints to start, pause, resume, and end sessions with server-side timers.
Broadcast session state via Socket.IO channels per room and per game slug.
Log hint sends, puzzle state changes, and operator notes for analytics.
notes: Ensure timers persist across server restarts via database state.
Add safeguards to prevent duplicate session start for same booking.
Socket.IO server events emit session/dashboard updates; timer broadcasts wired but lint/build errors remain pending.

todos.title: Create camera pipeline controller and monitoring
acceptanceCriteria: API to register cameras, manage credentials, and start/stop ffmpeg workers.
Health checks detect stalled HLS playlists and restart workers automatically.
Expose status for UI dashboard consumption.
notes: Store encrypted RTSP credentials and support MJPEG fallback.
Log restarts and errors for diagnostics.

todos.title: Implement event logging and audit trail
acceptanceCriteria: Persist significant actions (auth, bookings, session controls, hints) into events table.
Expose query endpoints with filtering by date, room, operator.
Ensure logs integrate with reporting module in Phase 5.
notes: Support export to CSV for compliance requests.
Add retention policy and archived flag.

todos.title: Establish backend automated tests and CI gates
acceptanceCriteria: Unit tests cover validation, pricing, booking conflict resolution, and RBAC guards.
Integration tests simulate booking-to-session lifecycle and camera control.
CI pipeline blocks merge on failures and publishes coverage metrics.
notes: Use vitest or tap for Fastify; include SQLite in-memory harness.
Target >=80% statement coverage as per quality gate.
Fix failing pnpm test command by reinstalling dependencies on target host to pull Rollup/esbuild native binaries before wiring CI.

todos.title: Evaluate Better-Auth adoption and session persistence
acceptanceCriteria: Compare current Fastify token store with Better-Auth capabilities for RBAC/ABAC and long-lived sessions.
Document migration plan covering token persistence, refresh flows, and audit logging.
Prototype integration in staging or confirm decision to retain current stack.
risks: Migration could disrupt current admin tooling if not planned.
notes: Add backup/cron requirements and tooling evaluation alongside auth provider decision.

todos.title: Design backup and cron automation for EscapePlan appliance
acceptanceCriteria: Document required cron jobs for database backups, cleanup, and log rotation.
Select storage target for backups (local + export path) with retention policy.
Provide scripts or systemd units ready for Phase 4 packaging.
risks: Missing backups could jeopardize pilot deployments.
notes: Coordinate with Better-Auth evaluation to ensure auth data included in backups.

todos.title: Implement structured logging and audit trail (Winston)
acceptanceCriteria: Adopt Winston (or equivalent) for structured Fastify logs with rotation.
Persist admin/audit events for critical actions (user changes, network tweaks).
Expose logs through API for admin console consumption.
risks: Log volume on Pi devices must stay within storage limits.
notes: Coordinate with Better-Auth decision so audit trail covers external provider hooks.

PHASE_5.name: Mobile Operations & Analytics
PHASE_5.description: Add mobile deployment workflows, kit management, analytics, and reporting required for field events.

todos.title: Implement mobile kit inventory and readiness module
acceptanceCriteria: Track portable props, puzzles, and hardware assigned to each mobile kit.
Provide pre-departure checklist and status indicators.
Integrate with scheduling to flag shortages.
notes: Include QR code scanning or manual entry for quick updates.
Support offline data entry with later sync.

todos.title: Build field event scheduling and routing tools
acceptanceCriteria: Enable assignment of staff, kits, and vehicles to mobile bookings.
Calculate travel buffers and detect route conflicts.
Provide day-of timeline printable/exportable for crews.
notes: Allow manual override for special events.
Include map link generation for navigation apps.

todos.title: Design offline sync strategy for mobile deployments
acceptanceCriteria: Specify data subsets cached on devices prior to events.
Handle conflict resolution when reconnecting after offline operations.
Document sync workflow for staff including manual triggers.
notes: Ensure sync handles media assets as needed without overloading storage.

todos.title: Produce session analytics and daily run sheets
acceptanceCriteria: Generate dashboard widgets for throughput, hint usage, and completion rates.

Enable export to CSV/PDF for business review.
notes: Leverage existing event logs and booking data.
Include occupancy forecast for upcoming days.

todos.title: Implement reporting exports and backup automation
acceptanceCriteria: Provide one-click export of bookings, sessions, and revenue summaries.
Automate compression and rotation of report archives.
Document restore workflow for audits.
notes: Keep exports within local network and support USB transfer.
Include checksum validation on backup files.

todos.title: Add operator alerts for downtime and hint backlog
acceptanceCriteria: Trigger local notifications when camera streams fail or timers paused unexpectedly.
Provide optional SMS/email gateway for when internet is available.

notes: Ensure notifications work within offline network using browser notifications or local display.
Allow operators to acknowledge and mute alerts.

PHASE_6.name: QA, Pilot, and Launch
PHASE_6.description: Validate quality, run pilot programs, prepare documentation, and package the MVP for release.

todos.title: Develop end-to-end test suite for core flows
acceptanceCriteria: Playwright tests cover login, booking creation, session control, and hint sending.
Tests execute on CI and on-device Pi harness.
Document test data management strategy.
notes: Include snapshot tests for dashboards on tablet resolutions.
Automate run via pnpm script referenced in tracker.

todos.title: Execute load and resilience testing on Raspberry Pi
acceptanceCriteria: Simulate concurrent sessions with multiple HLS streams and operators.
Measure CPU, memory, and network utilization against targets.
Document mitigation strategies for overload scenarios.
notes: Automate stress harness to replay camera feeds.
Capture data for future capacity planning.

todos.title: Complete security and privacy review
acceptanceCriteria: Perform threat model focusing on offline network and data exposure.
Run dependency and container scans, addressing high findings.
Publish security checklist with mitigation actions.
notes: Include physical security considerations for mobile kits.
Ensure compliance with data retention policies.

todos.title: Produce operator runbooks and training materials
acceptanceCriteria: Deliver printable and digital runbooks for store and mobile operators.
Include troubleshooting flowcharts for common incidents.
Create short video or slide deck for onboarding.
notes: Coordinate with design for consistent branding.
Store materials in project-docs/runbooks.

todos.title: Run pilot deployment and capture feedback
acceptanceCriteria: Conduct at least one in-store and one mobile pilot session.
Collect feedback from operators and participants within 24 hours.
Log action items back into backlog.
notes: Measure pilot against success metrics defined in P1-002.
Record environment details for reproducibility.

todos.title: Package release artifacts and deployment instructions
acceptanceCriteria: Produce signed .deb, Pi image, and checksum files for MVP release.
Update HANDOFF and INSTALL docs with step-by-step process.
Archive release bundle in versioned storage with rollback notes.
notes: Coordinate with backend/frontend leads for version alignment.
Verify install on fresh Pi before tagging release.

todos.title: Triage pilot findings and refresh roadmap
acceptanceCriteria: Aggregate pilot feedback into actionable backlog items.
Update roadmap for versions 0.2.x and beyond.
Share summary with stakeholders.
notes: Ensure lessons learned captured in session notes.
Highlight quick wins vs larger initiatives.

riskRegister.description: Raspberry Pi may struggle with multiple simultaneous HLS streams at 720p.
riskRegister.impact: Could degrade operator dashboard responsiveness and video quality.
riskRegister.mitigation: Optimize ffmpeg pipelines, limit concurrent streams, allow quality downgrade to MJPEG.

riskRegister.description: Competitors offer extensive CRM and marketing features that MVP will not include.
riskRegister.impact: May limit adoption if differentiators are unclear.
riskRegister.mitigation: Emphasize offline reliability and mobile event tooling in messaging; collect pilot testimonials.

riskRegister.description: Limited availability of USB AC600M adapters could delay deployments.
riskRegister.impact: Creates bottleneck for testing and pilot rollout.
riskRegister.mitigation: Identify alternate supported adapters and pre-order critical hardware.

riskRegister.description: Mobile operations requirements may expand scope beyond MVP timeline.
riskRegister.impact: Could delay pilot or reduce feature completeness.
riskRegister.mitigation: Prioritize must-have mobile features and defer advanced analytics post-launch.

riskRegister.description: Self-signed HTTPS certificates may be rejected by operator devices without manual trust installation.
riskRegister.impact: Delays setup and reduces confidence during pilot demos.
riskRegister.mitigation: Provide cert-export CLI, documented trust steps, and optional USB bundle for onboarding.

changes: Expanded MVP planning to cover competitors, hardware, and dual operations.
Populated phased TODO roadmap with 45 detailed tasks and dependencies.
Added risk register, milestones, and quality gate configuration.
